method: OLD is the row the APPLIED deep seed migrations/20261011_rf_refinery_<tier>_deep.sql wrote: the generator rebuilds the 132 VALUES lines from the banks before the recut (OLD_REF) and requires them to be that file's VALUES block byte for byte. No production access: OLD was not compared with a dump of the live rows; each migration refuses a row matching neither OLD nor NEW, and the owner-run rolled-back dry run is that comparison.
